Overview
Explore how SAP Digital Manufacturing supports end-to-end manufacturing processes to improve compliance, quality assurance, and operational efficiency through digitization and continuous innovation.
Demand planning and orchestration
Run capacity simulations with just a few clicks to support planning and improve resource utilization.
Run material requirements planning (MRP) either manually or automatically and easily convert planned orders into actual process orders.
Monitor real-time operations to allocate or reschedule employees and distribute work.
Manage workforce certifications and skills centrally or at the site level to support production.
Assign workers to shifts and resources, taking their absences, shift trading, and certifications or skills into account.
Build production schedules in advance and adapt in real time as unplanned events occur to keep planning, operations, and logistics aligned.
Run capacity simulations with just a few clicks to support planning and improve resource utilization.

Work management
Easily validate employee certifications and capture direct or indirect labor time with a time-tracking feature.
Reduce errors and ensure quality and compliance with access to clear and relevant work instructions.
Ensure tasks are performed, not forgotten, through an intuitive worker experience in a single, centralized environment.
Easily validate employee certifications and capture direct or indirect labor time with a time-tracking feature.

Production execution
Select and consume the right batch of materials based on real-time inventory, material characteristics, and recipe revision.
Identify which alternate materials can be used for production and update inventory in real time.
Easily consume unplanned, phantom, and corrective action materials to ensure product quality and track genealogy and inventory.
Ensure data accuracy and validation in production with real-time equipment connectivity, including integration with scales.
Support workers in reducing errors during confirmations with formulas at both material consumption (goods issue) and production (goods receipt) levels, integrated with the warehouse.
Run qualitative and quantitative quality checks against defined thresholds and automatically propose the next step of scrap or rework to drive manufacturing execution.
Ensure compliance with role-based electronic signatures.
Manage work-in-process inventory with real-time goods issues and goods receipts with the warehouse in a single solution, including lineside replenishments for single and cross-order demand.
Coordinate unplanned maintenance and cleaning by creating a production downtime window that triggers maintenance support.
Select and consume the right batch of materials based on real-time inventory, material characteristics, and recipe revision.

Analytics and genealogy
Save employees' time by allowing confirmations and goods movements to be posted after the fact, at the end of a shift or when moving to another work area.
Improve decision-making with real-time visibility over KPIs, including OEE and throughput from real-time yield and scrap quantities, performance and availability losses, downtimes, and more in the Line Monitor POD.
Support continuous improvements with real-time shop floor information using insights from SAP Analytics Cloud, embedded in Digital Manufacturing.
Use the Order Report app to view information about process and production orders and receive full traceability and compliance details at any time with operational analytic reports.
View detailed production genealogy information for all materials using the SFC Report app, which serves as the foundation for device history reports and electronic batch records.
Track and report product history with templatized PDFs.
Gain end-to-end visibility into the product lifecycle through full batch traceability and genealogy to meet regulatory requirements.
Save employees' time by allowing confirmations and goods movements to be posted after the fact, at the end of a shift or when moving to another work area.

Production process designer
Reduce manual operator effort with the Design Production Processes app, which enables a low-code/no-code approach to link human-to-machine events and machine-to-machine events.
Track the execution status of each step in the product lifecycle with the Monitor Production Processes app, which also includes debugging capabilities.
Extend and customize processes with event subscriptions, timers, and business rules in the Manage Automatic Triggers app.
Store and maintain equipment and production process parameters centrally in the Manage Set Points app and use them on demand.
